name: Hellbound
source:
Welcome to HELLBOUND: An indie game set in the slums of Baratrum City.

Years after the fall of his own crime syndicate, a half-demon named Zyne comes out of retirement for one last job- a heist that will bring down the city's biggest gang leaders. With his old reputation as EL DIABLO hanging over him, this time, he plans to finish things on his own terms.

Gathering a crew of misfits, he leads them on high-stakes missions, taking down rival gangs- each with their own reasons for joining the fight. But as Zyne climbs back into the underworld, his past as a mob boss resurfaces, along with the buried sins he'd thought he left behind.

This was supposed to be his final job... instead, it becomes his reckoning.

Now, Zyne and his crew must face the consequences of his past and decide whether he can truly walk away, or if the life he built in blood will drag him back down with it.
